reference.title: WHO global air quality guidelines: particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), ozone, nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide and carbon monoxide
reference.note: Guideline only — not a regulatory limit.

parameterDefinition.name: PM10
parameterDefinition.description: Inhalable particulate matter mass concentration. 24-hour averages apply for 24h criterion.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: See WHO AQG 2021 section 3.3.2.1 (pages 120-121) for method description.

criteria.methodNote: Defined as the 99th percentile of the annual distribution of 24-hour average concentrations (equivalent to ~3-4 days exceedance/year). Source: WHO AQG 2021, section 3.3.2.1, pp.120-121 (Table 3.9).

evidenceReference.quote: The recommendation is a short-term (24-hour) PM10 AQG level of 45 µg/m3, defined as the 99th percentile (equivalent to three to four exceedance days per year) of the annual distribution of 24-hour average concentrations.

curation.curationNotes: Curated PM10 24h criterion from WHO AQG 2021 with threshold and method from section 3.3.2.1 and Table 3.9 (pages 120-121).

validation.validationNotes: Evidence aligns with WHO AQG 2021 section 3.3.2.1 (pp.120-121): PM10 24-hour AQG value = 45 µg/m3, defined as the 99th percentile of annual distribution of 24-hour average concentrations (~3-4 exceedance days/year). Independent validation remains pending; therefore this record is not approved for use as a core criterion.
